notes.subject: strongpela haus
notes.rationale: ארמנות em i haushai bilong pait (citadel); "strongpela haus" i holim pies.

notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Propan long em (taun, ves 2) — Hibru i onli sufiks -eha.

translation: Elohim i stap long ol strongpela haus bilong ⟨em⟩, i kamap save long strongpela hai ples bilong salvim man.
